terminal_conventions.plug_terminals: AC plug contacts are labeled A/B only; the schematic does not key polarity, hot/neutral, or orientation.
terminal_conventions.switch_terminals: #16 switch contacts are labeled side_a/side_b as unordered mechanical terminals; the schematic does not assign a physical switch lug number.
terminal_conventions.tube_symbol_terminals: H1/H2 identify the left/right heater leads as drawn in the series-string figure; PLATE identifies a schematic symbol electrode. These are not socket pin numbers.
terminal_conventions.component_terminal_aliases: Two-terminal passive aliases are unordered unless the factory source gives polarity. #30 endA/tap/endB follow its 40-ohm and 80-ohm sections.
